github_rule: event from X-GitHub-Event (either case); action = payload.action or ''; refs always {} (adapters/github.py:249-257).
gitlab_rule: event from X-Gitlab-Event/X-GitLab-Event; action = object_attributes.action or payload.event_type or ''; repository_ref = payload.project or {}; code_review_ref set only when 'merge_request' in event.lower(); issue_ref only when 'issue' in event.lower() (adapters/gitlab.py:400-412). Empty body decodes to {}.
